rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation shows the filing total is internally correct: schedule fair value 35,500,450 divided by net assets 19,147,147 equals 185.405957%, matching the disclosed 185.4%. The source leaves percent of net assets blank on individual investment rows and reports percentages on subtotal and total rows. Therefore a check expecting the identity on every extracted position will fail by presentation design; the flag is a rule-scope false alarm rather than a source-data error. Residual risk is limited to the unavailable independent companyfacts comparison and the extract total being higher than the schedule total, which is a separate aggregate issue and does not overturn the percentage-presentation evidence.
